Usage.rationale: PotionUsage.CombatOnly means the game's Use button is live only during a fight. The sim reaches that by construction: `py audit/tools/potion_probes.py sweep-usage` finds exactly one `def use_potion` in sts2_rl/, on CombatState, and the conformance driver only dispatches the recording's UsePotion command inside a live fight (conformance/combat_driver.py:16,263-289). The absence of a `usage` attribute is therefore not a dropped guard for this unit -- but it IS a real gap for the four AnyTime potions, which is where the divergence is filed (blood_potion, entropic_brew, foul_potion, fruit_juice).

TargetType.maps_to: no attribute -- `targeted` stays False, so CombatState.use_potion passes target=None (combat.py:608) and the potion applies to ctx.player (potions.py:920-937)
TargetType.rationale: TargetType.Self in a single-player run always resolves to the owner: PotionModel.EnqueueManualUse defaults `target` to `Owner.Creature` when it is a valid target (PotionModel.cs:240-243) and IsValidTarget's Self/AnyPlayer arms accept exactly that creature (PotionModel.cs:280-287). The multiplayer half -- AnyPlayer letting you throw the potion at an ally, and CanThrowAtAlly (PotionModel.cs:381-388) gating it on `RunState.Players.Count > 1` -- is out of scope by the shared contract and noted in maps_to rather than verdicted as a divergence.

See the new seam/card_selection mechanism entry: the sim re-encodes C#'s two CardSelectorPrefs integers as a string-keyed boolean, and the two halves can silently disagree. WHAT REASONING THIS REPLACES: the ENUMERATION, not the verdict's logic.  The text it replaced read: CLOSED 2026-07-28 by the gap-queue continuation's section-A fix pass (this is a CODE change, not a re-reading of the old code). `min_select=0` is now passed at the call site (Ashwater.cs:30's CardSelectorPrefs MinSelect), so `floor` no longer collapses to `count` and the selectorless path -- CombatState's own default and full_env.py's documented `card_selector=None` option -- reaches every outcome from none to the whole hand. EXECUTED: 30 seeds give varying exhaust-pile sizes including 0, where the pre-fix code took all four every time.  The gap it replaced read: NARROWED 2026-07-27: partly closed. CombatState.select_cards now carries the missing pair -- `min_select: int | None = None` (combat.py:665-705), read at combat.py:693 into `floor`, with combat.py:699-702 letting the selectorless path return anywhere from `floor` to `count`, none included.
